title: Hitting-time comparison through an intermediate vertex
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of positive degree, and let $a,b,c$ be vertices. If there is a rational number $A$ such that, for every natural number $M$, the cumulative miss probability for hitting $b$ from $a$ through step $M-1$ is at most $A$, then for every natural number $N$ the cumulative miss probability for hitting $c$ from $a$ through step $N-1$ is at most $A$ plus the cumulative miss probability for hitting $c$ from $b$ through step $N-1$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular multigraph of positive degree
